$description: Provenance for the token sources in this directory. Written by the extraction step, read by build/build.mjs so every generated artefact can name the file, collection and mode it came from — and so a count that no longer matches is a build warning rather than a surprise six weeks later.

file.name: Pathfinder Design System V.3
file.extractedVia: Figma MCP · Plugin API — see build/figma-extract.js for the exact script

styles.note: Type is styles, not variables — sizes and line heights are literals in typography.tokens.json for that reason.

findings.claim: All 232 PF3 variables carry scopes = ALL_SCOPES.
findings.consequence: Every colour token appears in every property picker, so a designer choosing a stroke colour is offered text and background tokens too. Scoping is the mechanism that makes a large semantic tier usable in the canvas.
findings.fix: Bind border/* to STROKE, text/* and icon/* to TEXT_FILL, bg/* and surface/* to FRAME_FILL + SHAPE_FILL, space/* to GAP + WIDTH_HEIGHT.

findings.claim: Three legacy collections — _Legacy/Tailwind (269), _Legacy/Global Tokens (51), _Legacy/Semantic Tokens (132) — remain in the file alongside PF3, 452 variables in total.
findings.consequence: Nothing prevents a new frame binding to a retired generation, and the count in any documentation of 'how many tokens the system has' depends on which generation you believe.
findings.fix: A deprecation pass: mark, redirect, then remove at the next major. The underscore prefix is a convention, not an enforcement.

findings.claim: PF3/Semantic contains component-scoped names — bg/button-primary, bg/button-secondary, bg/button-destructive, border/input, border/input-focus, bg/table-header, bg/nav-active, bg/scrollbar, bg/tooltip.
findings.consequence: The semantic tier stops being the small re-themeable vocabulary it is meant to be, and grows once per component instead of once per meaning.
findings.fix: Either move them into a third collection, or accept a two-tier system and say so. The failure mode is claiming three tiers while shipping two.

findings.claim: border/focus and border/focus-ring resolve to blue/500, while border/input-focus resolves to purple/500.
findings.consequence: Focus reads as two different affordances depending on which control has it.
findings.fix: Pick one. The effect style PF3/Focus/Ring already commits to blue, which makes purple the outlier.

findings.claim: There is no motion collection: no durations, no easings.
findings.consequence: Every transition in code is a literal, so motion cannot be reviewed, re-themed, or reduced from one place.
findings.fix: primitive.duration.* exists in code only, marked $codeOnly, until it exists in the file.
